final_wiki.answer-Q-3521:
The greatest common divisor of 1155 and 945 is 105.

Calculation using Euclidean algorithm:
1155 = 945 × 1 + 210
945 = 210 × 4 + 105
210 = 105 × 2 + 0

Therefore GCD(1155, 945) = 105

Verification by prime factorization:
1155 = 3 × 5 × 7 × 11
945 = 3³ × 5 × 7
Common factors: 3 × 5 × 7 = 105
